msg: warning: Variable buf is used uninitialized!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): eef2317b9f5.c (BusyBox). Uninitialized value on 'buf' at line 31 ('free(buf)' — //ERROR annotation), when def(CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP). Same root cause as FAMILY_76: when 'goto all_done' is taken at line 23, 'buf' is never assigned by malloc. An uninitialized buf that happens to be truthy at the 'if (buf)' check still carries a garbage pointer value into free(buf), which is undefined behavior. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: def(CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP) is necessary and sufficient — same constraint analysis as FAMILY_76.
